endorsements.title: CHAI AI governance frameworks (playbooks)
endorsements.quote: Maintain a computing resource inventory that documents: Physical hardware (servers, GPUs, AI accelerators) used for AI training or inference Cloud service dependencies (which AI systems run on AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or private cloud)

endorsements.title: CHAI Responsible AI Guide (Assurance Standards Guide)
endorsements.quote: For this step, determine whether the implementer organization has documented a contingency plan for critical AI services, and if so, whether the organization has trained personnel on contingency plan implementation responsibilities. In addition, ascertain whether the organization's records document that the contingency plan has been tested.

endorsements.title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework: Generative AI Profile (NIST AI 600-1)
endorsements.issuer: National Institute of Standards and Technology
endorsements.quote: Establish policies and procedures that address GAI data redundancy, including model weights and other system artifacts.

endorsements.title: Healthcare 5.0-Driven Clinical Intelligence: The Learn-Predict-Monitor-Detect-Correct Framework for Systematic Artificial Intelligence Integration in Critical Care
endorsements.quote: Under crisis scenarios or network disruptions, a degraded “offline” mode can continue generating basic alerts leveraging locally cached models, guaranteeing the preservation of core functionality when connectivity is lost.

endorsements.title: Enhancing the resilience of remote patient monitoring and hospital-at-home systems: a digital-twin-based framework
endorsements.quote: Loss of availability is a predictable failure mode and needs to be addressed.

endorsements.title: Drone-delivered automated external defibrillators in prehospital emergency care: implementation evidence, bottlenecks, and conceptual integration with artificial intelligence and next-generation communications
endorsements.quote: The integrated system should also include fail-safe design and operational redundancy, so that failure of any single component does not interrupt the chain of survival.

commentary.bottom_line: Six sources, three frameworks and three commentaries, endorse including AI in continuity and disaster recovery plans, but no supplied study tests the practice or measures how often AI outages disrupt care. The recommendation rests on expert consensus and on reasoning by analogy from general IT continuity planning.

perspectives.view: No study in the supplied set tests whether mapping AI dependencies or documenting lost functionality changes outage duration, recovery time, or patient outcomes. No study documents the hazard either. The support consists of three frameworks and three commentaries, so certainty cannot be rated above no direct evidence.

The commentaries describe loss of availability as a predictable failure mode and propose fallbacks such as locally cached models and redundant components. These proposals are design reasoning. No supplied data show how often AI failures reach patients or whether documented contingency plans shorten the period of exposure to harm.

The CHAI playbook lists a computing resource inventory, including cloud dependencies, as a must. The CHAI assurance guide and NIST AI 600-1 frame contingency planning and data redundancy as should. These are voluntary frameworks, and the supplied sources cite no statute or rule that requires AI-specific continuity planning.

commentary.research_gap: Studies are needed that document the frequency and clinical consequences of AI outages and dependency failures in health systems. Studies are also needed that compare recovery time, workaround use, and adverse events between sites with and without AI-specific continuity plans and staff training.
commentary.underserved_note: No study tested the practice, so no evidence covers Medicaid, safety-net, limited English proficiency, or low-literacy populations. Safety-net systems may have fewer redundant resources, and it is unknown whether outage effects or the value of planning differ in those settings.
